hypothesis: Random-light filtering chooses one shared lit/unlit state for the selection.
proof: C selection_filter_mapchar draws rn2(2) independently for each terrain-matching selected cell. It does not consult the cell light bit in the -1 branch. JS matches the executed C points and RNG calls.
supportedSetup: Production terrain and l_selection_setpoint create a four-cell absolute selection: three ROOM cells and one HWALL. Two ROOM cells are unlit, one lit. A deterministic injected RNG returns valid values within each requested bound. No arbitrary Lua runtime or game-state overrides.
expectedC: See observations.json for exact selected coordinates and ordered RNG bounds.
observedJS: All 5 enumerated comparisons match C selections and ordered RNG calls; receiver retains its points.
control: Explicit lit=0/1 and no-light-filter -2 consume no draws; empty input consumes none. Target selects both an unlit and a lit cell, disproving a shared global light choice.
scope: Finite fixtures only; not universal filter equivalence or shipped recording evidence. Existing JS regression coverage is retained, and this adds an executed C oracle. Manual/unbound: do not invent a scanner suppression identity.
oracleProvenance: Exact selection_filter_mapchar/percent C bodies, minimal zero-initialized point/map storage, ROOM-only matching predicate and scripted rn2. Conservative whole-map bounds visit extra zero cells only, preserving selected-cell traversal and RNG sequence. Full Lua parser not executed.
